eras.label: current
eras.source: Missouri appellate judicial panel (backup redistricting process)
eras.note: The Senate's own bipartisan citizen commission deadlocked, triggering Missouri's constitutional backup process — a panel of appellate judges drew the map instead. Missouri's 2025 mid-decade congressional redistricting did not touch state legislative maps.
